name: One Night Ultimate Alien
summary: One-night hidden-role party game where villagers must find and vote to kill aliens infiltrating the village.
rules_text: Setup with 3 more role tiles than players. Each player secretly takes one role tile and a numbered seat token in circle order; three tiles go face-down to center. A mandatory app narrates the Night. Each role wakes in app order: aliens find each other, special roles like Oracle answer on the app, Cow offers a fist to tap, Groob and Zerb see each other, Leader checks for alien thumbs, Psychic looks at cards, Rascal swaps cards, Exposer flips center cards, Blob and Mortician have passive conditions. After Night, all discuss publicly and simultaneously vote by pointing; player with most votes dies (ties broken by second vote). Teams win if win condition met: villagers win if an alien dies, aliens win if no alien dies, plus special solo win conditions for Synthetic, Blob, Mortician, Groob/Zerb rivalries.
unmapped: mandatory companion app with variable per-game instructions
rating_reason: One Night Werewolf-style hidden roles, bluffing, perfect for engine
reasons: scope: spatial_board: out of scope by decision: the game depends on a spatial board (a grid, map, movement or adjacency)
